title: Rationale for Use of Annual Value Threshold for Zero-income Households for Long-term Healthcare Means-testing
what_it_is: Rationale for Use of Annual Value Threshold for Zero-income Households for Long-term Healthcare Means-testing

sections.label: Subsidy eligibility and care needs
sections.summary: Zero-income HDB households get the highest subsidy tier, and MOH and MOF are reviewing the subsidy framework's tiering.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: With the new AV threshold, zero-income households in all Housing and Development Board flats are eligible for the highest tier of subsidy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: What the Member is perhaps alluding to is that the eligibility criteria should cater greater financial support to a household living in a lower AV private property, but with significant care needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This has to do with the current tiering and design of the subsidy framework, which the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Finance are reviewing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding the above, where a family faces financial difficulties, there are avenues to apply for additional assistance beyond means-tested subsidies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Medical social workers holistically consider the clients' circumstances on a case-by-case basis, including scenarios where multiple household members require care.

sections.label: AV, income proxies and appeals
sections.summary: AV reflects means when household income is absent, and appeals allow subsidy deviation; the review will consider the Member's points.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In the absence of household income, AV is generally a good reflection of the means of an individual.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Per capita household income, as well as the AV measures, are proxies, but they are not perfect measures.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Because of that, we do have a mechanism for when there are certain specific situations, parties can proceed for an appeal.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And in that appeal we can actually consider circumstances and have subsidy deviation, which would then support them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We have also indicated that we are reviewing this, so whatever that the Member has raised are things that we will consider.
